review: The new Der Freischütz Outis ID is an absolute beast and a must-have for burn teams. Starting with her flaws, she only has two Sin Affinities, which greatly limits the amount of ego she can fuel with her kit. Magic Bullet Outis would also struggle a bit with battles that do not have that many enemies or abnos that do not have many parts. Still though, as a standalone ID, she is capable of inflicting Defense Level Down to enemies through her Dark Flame, up to 7. This would mean that if she inflicts 7 Dark Flame on the enemy, it's the equivalent of having 2 fragile to the enemy, which totals up to everyone dealing +20% more damage teamwide for the entire turn. When put on a burn team, burn is amplified to do damage multiplied by how much Dark Flame is on the enemy.
